description: Resource Type definition for AWS::CloudFront::FieldLevelEncryptionProfile. A field-level encryption profile maps CloudFront public keys and provider identities to the request-body field patterns that CloudFront encrypts with them.

EncryptionEntity.description: A public key, its provider identity, and the field patterns CloudFront encrypts with that key.

PublicKeyId.description: The identifier of the CloudFront public key used to encrypt the fields that match the patterns.

ProviderId.description: The provider associated with the public key. The same value must be supplied with the private key for an application to decrypt the data.

FieldPatterns.description: The request-body field names to encrypt. A pattern is either a full field name or leading characters followed by a wildcard (*). Patterns are case-sensitive and must not overlap.

FieldLevelEncryptionProfileConfig.description: The configuration of a field-level encryption profile.

Name.description: The name of the field-level encryption profile. Names are unique within an AWS account.

CallerReference.description: A unique value that identifies the creation request. Caller references are unique within an AWS account and cannot be changed after creation.

Comment.description: An optional comment describing the field-level encryption profile.

EncryptionEntities.description: The encryption entities of the field-level encryption profile. At least one entity is required.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the field-level encryption profile.

Id.description: The identifier that CloudFront assigns to the field-level encryption profile.

LastModifiedTime.description: The time the field-level encryption profile was last modified.
